title: The Scroll
hero_prompt: Ink-and-wash painting on paper in the manner of a Chinese landscape handscroll, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: one continuous painted landscape unrolling across the whole banner, a river winding from right to left past misty mountains, with tiny workshops, a kiln and a half-built boat along its banks, and at the far right edge the paper curls up into a thick roll still waiting to open. Soft greys, pale ochre and green washes on cream paper, plain dark margins, no red seal stamps.
icon_prompt: Ink-brush emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm cream ground, no shading or gradients: a hanging scroll, a thick horizontal roll at the top, a tall blank cream sheet hanging down from it outlined in thick black, and a second thick roll at the bottom, partly unrolled. Bold, high-contrast, blank sheet, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
